message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Hub for United Airlines; major gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and Delta; major gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Hub for American Airlines; major gateway to Latin America. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; major hub on the East Coast. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key airport for tourism. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark, NJ | EWR | Hub for United Airlines; major gateway to the Northeast. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) | Washington, DC | IAD | Hub for United Airlines; major airport serving the nation's capital. |

These airports serve as major hubs for domestic and international flights, handling millions of passengers each year and connecting travelers to destinations worldwide.
